name: Hikari Gojo_ox.HEAL_CLASS.Vermilia-7
original_name: 光五条_ox.癒種ヴァーミリア・ヘプト
source:
A Reyvatologist (a doctor who specializes on Reyvateils) who runs a clinic in Eternus Shaft.
He used to work as a medical doctor at the Archia Think Tank, but when he met a shocking revelation about the organization, he quit.
It seems like Richaryosha is involved with this issue, but...
